steps.label: Paket pruefen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat sr2_aa sr2_ab > sr2.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q sr2.tgz)" = aa21e81d61cae1ea43a7494e094797ff ] && mv sr/bundle/public srpub && rm -rf sr && mkdir sr && tar xzf sr2.tgz -C sr && mv srpub sr/bundle/public && ls sr/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render sr/bundle P sr_out2.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: Ton
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sr_out2.mp4 -i sr/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest sears_film2.mp4 && md5 -q sears_film2.mp4 > sr_done2.txt && ls -la sears_film2.mp4 >> sr_done2.txt
